title: The sharp Hermite-ratio upper-bound conjecture
statement:
Let $h_n(x)$ and $F_n(x)=h_n(x)/h_{n+1}(x)$ be the ratios considered above, and let $g_{\alpha,\beta}(x)$ denote the comparison function introduced in the paper. **Hermite-ratio upper-bound conjecture.**

$$
F_n(x)<g_{-\frac12,\frac12}(x)
$$

for all real $x$ and $n>\frac12$. This conjecture proposes the comparison function with parameters $\alpha=-\frac12$ and $\beta=\frac12$, which has the exact limiting values of $F_n(x)$ as $x\to\pm\infty$; its status is not resolved in the supplied text.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2009.05767

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of September 2020).
source_name: Javier Segura, “Comments on the paper "Universal bounds and monotonicity properties of ratios of Hermite and Parabolic Cylinder functions"”, arXiv:2009.05767 (2020).
